figure.plot_unit: per tank/two mouths; no doubled system trace

five_second_duration_interpretation: The ~5 s user report is total discharged duration, not a valve-opening time. The 1 s smoothstep valve opening in these reduced runs is an explicit model assumption. Because these runs stop at highest intake crown/reversal before gas ingestion, they cannot judge or predict total release over ~5 s.

historical_9bar_reference.qualification: Preserved historical comparator at 9 bar absolute with different tank capacity/fill/headspace; not a matched-inventory control.

initial_state_pressure_work_scales_metho: Each case summary gives p0*Vg0 and (p0-pamb)*Vg0, an ideal polytropic sealed expansion work-to-ambient bound, and numerical integral of (pg-pamb)dVwithdrawn through the crown event. Values are per tank; the two-tank aggregate doubles only under the explicit independent-identical-simultaneous assumption.
model: Existing frozen two-branch network reduced integrator; shared tank per run, two outlets, liquid-full lines, sealed uniform dry ideal-air headspace.
model_limits: All cases stop at highest generated-preview intake crown or predicted reversal; no tank emptying, gas-ingestion continuation, cavitation, or after-event extrapolation.
This is not a five-second total discharge prediction; model dynamics terminate before gas enters lines.
Liquid stored in primed lines remains constant in the model and is reported separately from cumulative discharge and tank inventory.
Tank length is volume-matched ideal flat-ended cylinder; endcaps/internal structure unknown.
Line geometry/inertance/intake crowns are reused prior assumptions pending CAD; no CGD fit or measured-geometry validation.
Dry ideal-air n=1.4 is the baseline, n=1 and 1.25 are thermodynamic references only, not fits.

network_and_geometry_scope.actual_device: Two tanks are not combined into one common reservoir. Total four-mouth metrics are only the postprocessed double for identical independent tanks with simultaneous equal valves.
network_and_geometry_scope.branches: Same prior provisional intake crowns, branch paths, line volumes, and inertances; two mouths per tank.
network_and_geometry_scope.lamellae: Four equally spaced first-pass lamellae are not represented in this reduced model; geometry worker is handling this separately.
network_and_geometry_scope.tank: Confirmed D=0.9m, liquid=1.35m3 per tank, gas headspace=20/22.5/25% of liquid. Ideal flat-ended cylinder length set by total volume; endcaps unmodeled.
network_and_geometry_scope.valve: D=0.3m reported; model retains Cd=0.7 scalar restriction, no disk/wake.

sealed_gas_full_displacement_limit.formula: For dry sealed gas with fixed mass and p V^gamma constant: p_final = p0 * (Vg0/Vtank)^gamma = p0 * [f/(1+f)]^gamma, where f=Vg0/Vl0 and Vtank=Vl0+Vg0. Critical f solves p0[f/(1+f)]^gamma = pamb.
sealed_gas_full_displacement_limit.limitations: This sealed-gas limiting estimate cannot continue physically after gas reaches/exposes the intake. Actual late response needs gas venting/ingestion, gravity, line inertia, possible CO2 transfer, and two-phase discharge; none are modeled here.

rows.qualification: Fixed-mass dry ideal gas, sealed, spatially uniform pressure, reversible polytropic expansion to total tank capacity; no outflow of gas and no valve/line/gravity effects. This is a limiting analytic calculation, not a full-drain prediction.
